text.en:
14th. NOVEMBER, 2001 No. S 73

SYARIAH COURTS EVIDENCE ORDER 2001 {S 63/2001) Notification under section 1(1) In exercise of the power conferred by section 1 ( 1), the Minister of Religious Affairs, with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, hereby appoints the 27th. day of Rejab, 1422 Hijriah corresponding to the 15th. day of October, 2001 as the date on which the Syariah Courts Evidence Order, 2001 (with the exception of section 5) shall commence. Dated this 3rd. day of Syaaban, 1422 Hijriah corresponding to the 20th. day of October, 2001. PEHIN JAWATAN LUAR PEKERMA RAJA DATO SERI UTAMA DR. USTAZ HAJI AWANG MOHD. ZAIN BIN HAJI SERUDIN Minister of Religious Affairs, Brunei Darussalam.
